verdict.rationale: Superset lets a user 'pick an agent' from a list (Claude Code, Codex, Amp, Gemini, OpenCode, Cursor Agent, etc.) when creating a workspace, effectively letting an engineering-lead choose a specific agent/model rather than relying on any default, and this choice is explicit in the prompt-first flow. However, there is no evidence of finer-grained model selection within a given agent (e.g., choosing GPT-4 vs Claude within one agent) or of an 'automatic' selection mode being overridden. Missing for 10: explicit model-level (not just agent-level) selection controls, and confirmation that a default/automatic model choice exists that can be overridden.
